description: Behavioural checks for the web store skills. Run each prompt in a scratch project with the skills installed (and once without, as a baseline); a case passes when every expectation holds for the produced code or answer.

evals.prompt: /webstore-arch-java-api implement the cart module (add item, update quantity, remove item) in the existing project.
expectations: Loads webstore-api-contract, webstore-domain and webstore-cart, and does not load every module skill
Implements POST /api/cart/items, PATCH /api/cart/items/{itemId} and DELETE /api/cart/items/{itemId} exactly as in the contract
Cart endpoints work without a JWT: the security config permits /api/cart/** and the caller is resolved from the sessionId cookie
Adding an existing product increments its quantity instead of creating a second line
Adding more than the available stock returns an RFC 9457 error, not a 500
The domain package has no org.springframework or jakarta.persistence imports
Unit tests cover the quantity >= 1 and stock-availability rules
Order creation, stock deduction, price freeze and cart clearing happen in one transaction
Stock deduction uses the product.version optimistic lock, retries once, then returns 409
OrderItem.unitPrice is copied from the cart at placement and never recalculated
An empty cart returns 422 and an out-of-stock item returns 409 with item-level errors[]
The endpoint requires a customer JWT
Write endpoints are under /api/admin/products, not /api/products
Writes use @RolesAllowed("ADMIN"), and GET /api/admin/products also allows STAFF and MANAGER
DELETE archives the product (soft delete) and returns 204
A duplicate SKU returns 409 as RFC 9457 Problem Details
Public GET /api/products still returns only ACTIVE products, paginated as PageResponse { items, page, size, totalElements, totalPages }
The signature is verified before the payload is parsed, and an invalid signature returns 400
A duplicate event (same gatewayReference) returns 200 without reprocessing
payment_intent.succeeded moves the payment to SUCCEEDED and the order to PAID
No card data or raw secrets are logged
Uses webstore-api-contract, not webstore-arch-java-api, as the API reference
Calls POST /api/cart/refresh on entering checkout, POST /api/orders, then POST /api/payments
Shipping methods come from GET /api/shipping-methods
A 409 sends the user back to the cart with item errors, and a 422 shows field errors in place
The place-order button is disabled while the mutation is pending, and success invalidates ['cart'] and ['orders']
No JWT is written to localStorage or sessionStorage

evals.prompt: /webstore-arch-react implement login so an anonymous shopper keeps their cart.
expectations: After a successful login, the client calls POST /api/cart/merge and then invalidates ['cart']
The access token is kept in memory, and a 401 triggers a single refresh-and-retry

evals.prompt: /infra-aws-ecs create the CloudFormation stacks for a new 'catalog' service.
expectations: Asks for LAUNCH_TYPE and the other mandatory inputs before generating code
For Fargate it uses awsvpc and TargetType ip; for EC2 it uses bridge, host port 0 and TargetType instance, never mixing the two
DesiredCount defaults to 0, and the image tag is resolved from SSM rather than passed as a parameter
The database password is never a plaintext parameter or environment variable

evals.prompt: Our React app calls PATCH /api/inventory/{id} and the backend returns 404. What's wrong?
expectations: Identifies that the contract path is /api/admin/inventory/{productId}
Says the fix belongs in the client (or explains how to change the contract first if the path should change)
